# Why my sourdough stopped rising (and the fix)

For three weeks every loaf came out flat and dense. The starter bubbled, the dough felt fine, and still nothing rose in the oven. Here is what was wrong.

The culprit turned out to be the kitchen itself. Winter had dropped the room to about seventeen degrees, and at that temperature my usual four-hour bulk ferment simply was not long enough.

## The fix

I now judge the bulk ferment by the dough, not the clock. When it has grown by about half, feels airy and jiggles when the bowl is shaken, it is ready, whether that takes four hours or seven.

> Watch the dough, not the timer.

## 2 thoughts on “Why my sourdough stopped rising”

Same thing happened to me last winter. I started proofing in the oven with just the light on and it made a huge difference.
